question:
The radius of \(\odot O\) is \(5\), and chord \(AB=8\). What is the distance from the center to \(AB\)?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_251_q1_question_en.svg)
solution: The perpendicular from the center to the chord bisects the chord, so half the chord has length \(4\). By the Pythagorean theorem, the distance is \(\sqrt{5^2-4^2}=3\).
